name: GPU-based Ray Shooting for Volumetric Mapping
aliases: GPU-Accelerated Ray Shooting for Probabilistic Volumetric Mapping
definition: A method to accelerate probabilistic volumetric mapping by converting octree leaf-level voxels to Axis-Aligned Bounding Boxes (AABBs) on the GPU, building a BVH, and shooting rays in parallel to determine voxel occupancy (free/occupied).
summary: GPU-based Ray Shooting for Volumetric Mapping accelerates Probabilistic Volumetric Mapping by using DirectX Raytracing to intersect rays with AABBs, replacing slow CPU-based methods.
